import subprocess,json,hashlib
p='docs/research/m03-packet-checks-2026-10-03.json'
r=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',':'+p]))
old=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','26f09166102fca44d486769796eb8f2598d4f5ba:'+p]))
assert r['predecessor']['snapshot']==old
assert r['status']['implementation']=='not_started'
assert len(r['files'])==8
buf=subprocess.check_output(['git','cat-file','--batch'],input=('\n'.join(':'+x['path'] for x in r['files'])+'\n').encode())
o=0
for a in r['files']:
 end=buf.index(b'\n',o); head=buf[o:end].split(); size=int(head[2]); o=end+1; b=buf[o:o+size]; o+=size+1
 assert size==a['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==a['sha256'],a['path']
print('Staged8 packet file byte/hash pins and exact historical snapshot: PASS')
